content.title: The Moth Comes Out
content.narrative:
YY heard the fence post click while he was pretending not to watch it.

A dry knot in the old fence post splits open with a papery click, and a dusty moth crawls out into the sun. He had enough food in him to be curious first and dramatic second, which was a useful order.

"Well," YY said. "That is not snack-shaped. Rude, but interesting."

YY guarded the knot-hole long enough for the moth to lift clear, losing a forage hour but keeping the moment whole. No one had asked him to name it. That helped. YY liked a thing better when it did not arrive wearing a job.

By sundown his food had moved from 0.67 to 0.69, health from 0.86 to 0.87, and attention from 0.74 to 0.76. YY did not say the numbers out loud. He did say, very softly, "Noted."

He came home with the the moth comes out behind him, a little more food than he woke with, and one clear place in the wood changed enough to remember.
